The vendor and operating developer directly providing **AIChatting** at **aichatting.net** is **Wegital HK Limited** (also operating under the brand name **AIChatting**).

### Evidence:
* **Developer & Legal Entity Listings:** Official mobile app store listings for *AI Chatting - AI Chatbot* (which link directly to the domain `aichatting.net`, support email `contact@aichatting.net`, and legal pages `https://www.aichatting.net/privacy-policy.html` and `https://www.aichatting.net/terms-of-service.html`) identify the operating developer as **Wegital HK Limited**:
  * *Google Play:* Developer listed as **Wegital HK Limited** (Address: *Rm F 6/F Mega Cube 8 Wang Kwong Rd, Kowloon Bay, Kowloon, Hong Kong*; Support contact: `contact@aichatting.net`).
  * *Apple App Store:* Developer listed as **WEGITAL HK LIMITED**.
* **Website Provider Brand:** The website footer at **aichatting.net** identifies the provider brand as **AIChatting** with copyright notices (e.g., *"Copyright © Aichatting. All Rights Reserved."*) and contact email `contact@aichatting.net`.
